title: Leaderboard reset button is tappable below the 120px floor until the proxy wraps
evidence:
street.gd _show_leaderboard:
	reset.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(0, 110)
	reset.pressed.connect(_on_reset_pressed)
	card["box"].add_child(reset)
	_open_popup(card["panel"])
	var last_rect := Rect2()
	for _i in range(300):
		await get_tree().process_frame
		if not is_instance_valid(reset):
			return
		var rect := reset.get_global_rect()
		if rect == last_rect and rect.size != Vector2.ZERO:
			break
		last_rect := rect
	if is_instance_valid(reset) and _reset_proxy != null:
		_reset_proxy.wrap(reset, FinLitTouchTargets.Role.SECONDARY)

street.gd _open_popup (card added, proxy retired same call):
	FinLitJuice.pop_in(card)
	...
	_hide_touch_proxies()

street.gd _hide_touch_proxies:
func _hide_touch_proxies() -> void:
	if _reset_proxy != null:
		_reset_proxy.visible = false

juice.gd pop_in (scales the card, so the button's hit area shrinks mid-tween):
	ctrl.scale = Vector2.ONE * 0.9
	t.tween_property(ctrl, "scale", Vector2.ONE, 0.28)
detail: The 110px reset button is live-connected while the proxy enlarging its hit area stays hidden until the settle loop ends (~0.28s pop-in + frames). During that window it is tappable at <120px (scale 0.9 => ~99px), below the floor the story enforces. No guard defers interactivity until wrap.
recommended_fix: Set reset.disabled = true (or mouse_filter = MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE) before _open_popup and clear it only after _reset_proxy.wrap(...) returns, so no sub-floor tap is live before the proxy guards the target.
